metaCapiReady.comment: Single source of truth: true iff metaCapiEnabled=true AND a linked active (non-deleted) MetaCapiDataset exists. Maintained by Funnel/BeforeSave/SyncMetaCapiReady and MetaCapiDataset/AfterSave/SyncReferencingFunnelsReady. Read by OpportunityStage via the foreign field `funnelMetaCapiReady` to drive UI panel visibility — no per-stage duplication.
